evidence_note: The official Large Scale Electronics Manufacturing PLI guidelines cover mobile phones and specified electronic components. They do not provide a reconciled HS-4 production, demand-coverage, or localisable-share measure for HS 8517.

The official ACC battery PLI page describes the scheme and allocated manufacturing capacity. It does not provide a reconciled installed-capacity, domestic-demand-coverage, or localisable-share measure for the mixed-use HS 8507 heading.

The official India Semiconductor Mission page lists semiconductor schemes, approved projects, and programme milestones. It does not provide a reconciled HS-4 production, capacity, demand-coverage, or localisable-share measure for HS 8542.

HS 8541 mixes photovoltaic cells with other semiconductor devices. The cited ministry page provides sector context but does not support a single HS-4 production, demand-coverage, or localisable-share measure.

The official IT Hardware PLI 2.0 page covers laptops, tablets, all-in-one PCs, servers, and ultra-small-form-factor devices. It does not provide a reconciled HS-4 production, demand-coverage, or localisable-share measure for HS 8471.

Domestic oil palm cultivation is highly constrained. The NMEO-OP targets a total production of 2.8 million MT by 2029-30 (an increase of ~2.42 million MT from the 2024-25 baseline of 0.38 million MT). Absolute substitution capped structurally.

Domestic soybean oil production relies on local seed crush. Yields for soya beans (HS 1201) are stagnant at ~1 MT/ha compared to global 3 MT/ha. Expansion is limited by rainfed cultivation and lack of GM seed approval.

Sunflower cultivation has declined in India (primarily Karnataka/Maharashtra) due to vulnerability to pests and climate variability. Domestic crush yields very little oil relative to the massive import demand.
India is self-sufficient in soybean seeds for direct crush, but the absolute volume is insufficient to meet the vegetable oil demand. The crop competes with other Kharif crops for land.
Domestic DAP production is heavily reliant on imported rock phosphate and phosphoric acid. The 57% import dependence is structural due to lack of domestic reserves.
India produces over 30M MT of urea domestically but remains a net importer due to massive consumption (36M MT). Production relies on imported natural gas (LNG).
India has negligible domestic gold mine production (Hutti Gold Mines). Almost 100% of demand is met through imports of unwrought or semi-manufactured gold.

Electric motors and generators: India has extensive domestic manufacturing capacity (CG Power, Bharat Bijlee, Siemens India, ABB India, Kirloskar Electric). High-efficiency IE3/IE4 motors produced locally; specialized servo motors and megawatt-scale high-voltage drives imported.

Flat-rolled carbon steel plates and structural steel: SAIL, Tata Steel, JSW Steel, and JSPL produce comprehensive ranges of hot-rolled plates and coils. Specialised high-tensile and ultra-thick boiler-quality plates imported.

Ball and roller bearings: Major domestic manufacturing footprint by SKF India, Timken India, NBC Bearings (NEI), NRB Bearings, and Schaeffler India. Standard ball and taper roller bearings manufactured locally; high-precision machine tool spindle bearings and large slewing bearings imported.

Industrial valves and taps: Strong domestic manufacturing ecosystem (L&T Valves, Audco, Microfinish, KSB, Forbes Marshall). Standard globe, gate, ball, and check valves produced in India; high-pressure subsea valves and electro-hydraulic control valves imported.

Articles of iron or steel, forgings and fabrications: Extensive domestic forging and heavy fabrication capacity (Bharat Forge, Ramkrishna Forgings, L&T Heavy Engineering). Precision forged blanks and heavy structural fabrications manufactured locally.

Pumps for liquids: Robust domestic pump manufacturing industry (Kirloskar Brothers, KSB India, Shakti Pumps, WPIL, Texmo). Agricultural, industrial centrifugal, and slurry pumps produced locally; specialized high-pressure boiler feed and cryogenic pumps imported.

Control panels, switchboards and power distribution centers: Directional industry context indicates domestic panel-building and switchgear integration activity. Product-level evidence is still required for advanced PLC processor cards, power-electronics modules, capacity, quality, and scale.

Transmission shafts, gears, gearboxes and clutches: Established industrial gear and transmission manufacturing (Elecon Engineering, Shanthi Gears, Premium Transmission, Bharat Gears). Standard helical and spur gearboxes produced locally; precision planetary and harmonic drive gearboxes imported.

Stainless steel and alloy steel ingots/blooms: Produced by Jindal Stainless, Alloy Steels Plant (SAIL), and MIDHANI. Standard austenitic stainless steel grades (304, 316) produced locally; specialized ESR-melted die steel and superalloy grades imported.

Moulds, mould bases and moulding patterns: Domestic toolroom network in tooling clusters (TAGMA India, NTTF, MSME Tool Rooms). Medium-scale plastic injection moulds and die-casting dies manufactured locally; large complex automotive body moulds and high-precision multi-cavity medical moulds imported.

Parts and accessories for machine tools: IMTMA reports provide directional context on Indian machine-tool activity. Product-level evidence is still required for machine structures, turrets, spindles, linear-motion systems, controllers, capacity, quality, and scale.
